source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 20 September 1946, p. 3 ("County and rural council nominations": Ballymena rural district)
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Unopposed returns read on the page image of the Belfast News-Letter, 20 September 1946, p. 3 (the Ballymena rural district list: 'Unopposed returns are:-', 21 divisions, the name as filed); the Northern Whig's 'Rural council nominations' of the same day (p. 3), cited before, has no Ballymena list.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 3 October 1946. Two divisions were contested; the remaining twenty-one were filled unopposed at the nominations of 19 September. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of the Belfast News-Letter, 20 September 1946, p. 3 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the unopposed return is now cited to the page that prints it (was the Northern Whig, 20 September 1946, p. 3, whose rural nominations list omits Ballymena); the name is unchanged.
